scientific_question: Which parts of late-Quaternary climatic history carry distinct ecological-predictor information, and which preregistered genetic outcomes gain out-of-species predictive skill from the tested history magnitude?

response_blind_predictor.claim: historical relation is nonredundant with current climate, source/target identity, taxonomy, sampling imbalance and a frozen 500-km geographic co-opportunity measure

genetic_endpoints.metric: mean within-heldout-species Spearman transfer statistic after frozen IBD adjustment
genetic_endpoints.limitation: different genetic transfer statistic from history-added He/Fst/break location; significant self test is relative to its structural null, not positive raw self correlation

genetic_endpoints.metric: relative heldout equal-study-group MSE reduction from adding single 21ka-to-current history term
genetic_endpoints.limitation: population expected heterozygosity contrast, not spatial break location or genetic differentiation; near-zero point estimate with CI overlapping zero

genetic_endpoints.metric: relative heldout group-equal MSE reduction from adding single history displacement term
genetic_endpoints.limitation: California-only population Fst pairs, missing coordinate-error fields, and uncertain underlying publication independence from He

genetic_endpoints.metric: species-equal mean heldout AUC difference adding single historical displacement magnitude to 11 baseline controls
genetic_endpoints.limitation: backgrounds are surveyed-range availability not known absence of breaks; barriers are reconstructed and some original author baseline covariates unavailable

interpretation.supported: Late-Quaternary climatic displacement relation contains distinct predictor geometry after specified current climate and geographic controls; sampled history magnitude is broadly position-stable within frozen 50km uncertainty.
interpretation.unsupported: A generalizable added predictive association with post-IBD COI transfer, He contrasts, Fst magnitude, or mapped mammalian break location under their own frozen designs.
interpretation.unknown: Which specific historical path, refugium, biotic interaction, demographic process, ancestral occupancy or lineage-by-landscape mechanism generated present genetic structures.
interpretation.caution: Finite conditional non-detections are neither demonstration of biological zero nor causal absence of glacial effects. Future mechanisms require new independent preregistered datasets, not rescue of these opened responses.
